description: Fetch current readings from one source, each with value, unit, a one-line summary, place and provenance (source, URL, fetch time, licence). Sources this server will not republish (non-commercial, restricted or unreviewed licence) answer with an error naming the licence.

bbox.description: noaa-nwps only: xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax in degrees (≤400 sq deg); default the Great Lakes basin.

coops.description: NOAA CO-OPS station id(s), comma-separated, e.g. 9063085.

elevated.description: usgs-volcanoes only: true keeps volcanoes above normal.

lat.description: Ad-hoc point latitude (with lng). For weather and WSI.

since.description: ISO date or datetime; only readings at or after it.

source.description: A source id with a fetcher (search_sources with fetchable=true).

state.description: epa-echo only: two-letter US state, default OH.

tag.description: Catalogue places with this tag, e.g. waterfowl, ice-fishing.

usgs.description: USGS monitoring location id(s), e.g. USGS-04193500.

name: get_readings
